summary: Rusk County, WI tower near Ladysmith, listed as standing; build date not found. A 1949 note mentions someone staying at the tower; the 1932 ranger station is a separate record.

events.note: One person described as staying at the tower, per a June 23, 1949 Chippewa Herald-Tribune item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. Not evidence of a formal staffing program.

notes_for_editor: Tower history not found: no build year, height, builder, design or fate. The WHS station record (HI20350) describes a ranger station, not the tower, and we did not confirm the tower sits on the same site (record coordinates 45.46458, -91.13424; station address W8945 Highway 8 not geocoded). Related WHS records HI20346 (garage, 1934) and HI20348 (oil house, 1937) are the same station and were not used for the tower. A search snippet claimed a staffing roster and that only three Rusk County towers were in active use; that came from an undated document we could not fetch, so it is not used. Blue Hills (Rusk County, also listed standing) is not researched here. Access unknown.
